intro: Our display unit is made for book lovers & décor enthusiasts alike. With sturdy shelves, protective glass panels, & hidden storage, it creates a space that's both personal & perfectly put together.

features.title: Strong enough for your heaviest books
features.text: Designed to hold even the heaviest hardcovers, our unit keeps your book collection safe, stable, and beautifully displayed for years to come.

features.title: Tempered glass shutters for protection
features.text: Sleek yet sturdy glass panels keep dust away while offering a clear view of your books and décor, adding both convenience and style.

features.title: Drawer for extra storage
features.text: Built-in drawer provide hidden storage for papers, accessories, or anything you want to keep out of sight but within easy reach.

features.title: Premium hardware for lasting strength
features.text: Smooth, durable fittings ensure effortless drawer movement and long-term reliability, so your unit stays as strong as it looks.

features.title: Storage that adapts to you
features.text: With a mix of open shelves, enclosed storage, and a spacious top, this unit is designed to fit books, décor, and keepsakes just the way you like.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
